name: music_notes_off
notes: all voices owned by music: forced note off, owner/priority 0; clears music-playing bit (C5E1 bit 0)

name: music_play
notes: (far ptr song, fade, vol): pos = ptr+2, master_vol, countdown 1, reclaim voices; game always passes 0,0

name: music_stop
notes: (mode): 0 = stop now; bit 7 = stop at next loop/Bx event; else fade-out speed (unused)

name: voice_release
notes: (u16 voice): end an effect on a voice: free its slot, forced note off, owner/priority/noteword/note 0, clear C5E1 bit 2; ignores v > 15 and owners <= 1

name: music_claim_voices
notes: every voice not held by an effect with priority > 40h -> owner 1 (music), priority 40h; bug: calls voice_release(owner id) instead of the voice (unreachable)

name: music_resume
notes: continue the loaded song from its current position if ready and stopped (wait 1, claim voices); no callers

name: music_enable
notes: set C5E0 bit 0; no callers

name: music_disable
notes: if playing: notes off and clear C5E0 bit 0; no callers

name: music_init
notes: (device 0/1/2/4/8xh): probe hardware, load INSTR.DAT bank, select routines, else PC speaker

name: snd_identity_chmap
notes: C748[1..cx] = 1..cx (Tandy 2, CMS 5)

name: snd_reset_tables
notes: zero DS:C638..C799, copy default velocity/channel tables C79A -> C6B8 (A0h bytes)

name: snd_select_routines
notes: BX = device index 0-4: C5E3 = C901[bx]; copy routine pointers C92E.. -> C906..C90E and freq tables C91A/C924 -> C916/C918; AdLib: silent snare strike

name: instr_load
notes: SI = section: open INSTR.DAT, skip SI sections, skip name, read 162h bytes to DS:C638, DOS-alloc count*size and read the instruments (far C96A)

name: music_reset
notes: device all-off, clear C83D..C852; no callers

name: snd_tick
notes: timer tick (145.65 Hz, from 0c1c:10e8): clear voice_busy, sfx_modulate, sfx_step, music fade, run due music events

name: music_fade
notes: per tick fade of master_vol C5DE (fade-in branch unreachable: bug); unused by the game

name: mus_ev_note_off
notes: event 8x: device note off if voice <= 13

name: mus_ev_note_on
notes: event 9x: vel 0 = off; vel = clamp(vel + C6B8[program]) + master_vol, 1..127; device note on, priority 40h

name: mus_ev_loop
notes: event Ax: count 0 = loop start; else loop end with total pass count; per-voice state C853/C859/C85F/C865

name: mus_ev_stop_point
notes: event Bx: stop if music_ctl bit 7

name: mus_ev_program
notes: event Cx: voice_program = prog; device program change

name: mus_ev_loop_exit
notes: event Dx: jump to loop_exit of the voice

name: mus_ev_hook
notes: event Ex: call DS:C914 (ret)

name: mus_ev_end
notes: event Fx: FC = stop song (halt, music_notes_off)

name: voice_alloc_check
notes: carry = reject: effect-owned voice with higher priority, or (non MPU) a same-tick note that is not higher; claims the voice for music

name: mpu_reset
notes: MPU-401 command FFh twice

name: mpu_program
notes: MPU: D0h, Cx+voice, C638[prog]

name: mpu_note_on
notes: MPU: D0h, 9x+voice, note (rhythm voice: C758[note-36]), velocity

name: mpu_set_freq
notes: MPU: pitch bend from note word fraction

name: mpu_note_off
notes: MPU: forced = controller 7Bh (all notes off), else 8x note 0

name: mpu_command
notes: AH = command to port 331h, wait for ACK FEh

name: mpu_data
notes: AL = data byte to port 330h

name: mpu_all_off
notes: MPU commands D0h, B9h

name: mpu_load_bank
notes: AX & 7Fh = INSTR.DAT section; C974 = loaded

name: adlib_set_tl
notes: SI = voice slot index: TL = 63 - vel/2 for carriers (and modulators of slots > 6 or CA15[slot]), else instrument TL CA05[slot]

name: adlib_note_on
notes: BL voice, CH note, DL vel, CL fraction, DH priority: voice 9 = rhythm (CA30/C758/BD), else note-19, alloc check, key off, TL, key on

name: note_fold
notes: fold CH into AL..AH by octaves, store voice_noteword

name: adlib_set_freq
notes: voices 0-8: A0h+v = fnum low, B0h+v = fnum high | block<<2 | key-on shadow

name: adlib_note_off
notes: voice 9: clear BD bit, noteword[9] = 0; voices 0-8: if forced or the note matches, clear key-on and zero voice_noteword/voice_note

name: adlib_load_instrument
notes: CH = instrument: 9 bytes -> 20/40/60/80 of both slots, byte 8 -> register C0h (sic, not C0h+voice)

name: adlib_program
notes: voices 0-5: load instrument C638[prog]; voices 6+: voice_program = CA25[voice]

name: adlib_all_off
notes: clear key-on B0h..B8h but with the shadow of BX for every channel (bug), BD = 20h; only caller is the dead music_reset

name: adlib_load_bank
notes: instr_load(0), then instrument CA25[v] into voices 10..0

name: cms_detect
notes: Game Blaster probe at 220h-22Fh

name: cms_note_on
notes: Game Blaster (parked)

name: cms_set_freq
notes: Game Blaster (parked)

name: cms_note_off
notes: Game Blaster (parked)

name: cms_reset
notes: Game Blaster (parked)

name: spk_note_on
notes: PC speaker: note-24, one voice, port 61h |= 3

name: spk_set_freq
notes: PC speaker: PIT ch 2 divisor = CAAA[semi] >> octave

name: spk_note_off
notes: PC speaker off if the note matches

name: spk_all_off
notes: port 61h &= FCh

name: tandy_note_on
notes: Tandy SN76489 (parked)

name: tandy_set_freq
notes: Tandy (parked)

name: tandy_note_off
notes: Tandy (parked)

name: tandy_all_off
notes: Tandy (parked)

name: voice_modulate
notes: AL voice, SI slot*2: noteword += slide + step; device set_freq if changed

name: sfx_modulate
notes: per tick: vibrato counters, modulate effect slots 2..1 and music voices (slot 0 values)

name: freq_lookup
notes: CH note, CL fraction -> AX = freq_table[n%12] + (CL>>4)*freq_step[n%12], CL = octave

name: sfx_start
notes: (near script ptr, priority) -> voice or FFFFh: take voice 5 (slot 2) or 4 (slot 1), lower priority first

name: sfx_step
notes: per tick: one script opcode per active slot (CB3C table) unless waiting

name: sfx_op_slide
notes: op 1 (sign, n)

name: sfx_op_slide_off
notes: op 2

name: sfx_op_vibrato
notes: op 3 (period, step): triangle LFO on the note word

name: sfx_op_vibrato_off
notes: op 4

name: sfx_op_wait
notes: op 5 (ticks)

name: sfx_op_note
notes: op 6 (note, vel): key off, note on with the effect priority

name: sfx_op_loop_end
notes: op 8 (x, count): count+1 passes, 0 = forever

name: sfx_op_loop_start
notes: op 7 (x)

name: sfx_op_end
notes: op 9 (and opcodes > 12, e.g. 00FFh): voice_release, slot reset, pointer 0

name: sfx_slot_reset
notes: op 10 and part of op 9: clear slot loop/vibrato/slide state (and CB0B), vib count 1, wait 1

name: sfx_op_program
notes: op 11 (p): device program with C638[p] (mapped through C638 twice on AdLib)

name: sfx_op_goto_engine
notes: op 12 (addr): become effect id 1 (engine) unless engine off (C900) or already playing, else end

name: sfx_init
notes: (device): like music_init for the effect side, sets C5E0 bit 2

name: sfx_stop_all
notes: voice_release for the voices of slots 2..0

name: dos_free
notes: (far ptr): INT 21h/49h

name: adlib_write
notes: AL = register, AH = value: 388h/389h with 6 and 35 status-read delays

name: adlib_detect_reset
notes: timer-based OPL detection; clears F5h..01h, 04h=60h, BDh=20h (rhythm mode), 01h=20h; AX = found

name: timer_isr
notes: INT 8 at 145.65 Hz: snd_tick, DS:00A0++, chain to the old INT 8 every 8th tick

name: sfx_play
notes: (id): far C wrapper of sfx_play_ax

name: sfx_play_ax
notes: AX = effect id (0 = stop all, |80h = stop id): checks sound on/replay/effects off, priority DS:915E, script DS:918E

name: engine_sound
notes: per frame: start effect 1, pitch from DS:129C -> voice_noteword directly (see sound.md)

name: snd_init
notes: once: sfx_init, music_init with DS:0096, DS:0096 = C5E3, timer_install; DS:009C = 1

name: music_for_state
notes: (arg): plays the music of main state DS:0086 (THEME / menu buffer / scene A-C by arg)

name: music_play_theme
notes: stop, load THEME.MUS into DS:E7F0, play

name: snd_shutdown
notes: sfx_play(0), music_stop(0), timer_restore; DS:009C = 0

name: snd_device_cfg
notes: TD3.CFG sound device 0-4 (3 -> 81h MT-32); after snd_init = C5E3 device id

name: music_off
notes: Ctrl-Q toggle

name: sfx_off
notes: Ctrl-S toggle; set for MT-32

name: snd_on
notes: sound system initialised

name: sfx_15_16_started
notes: set when effect 0Fh/10h starts

name: sfx_priority
notes: per effect id

name: sfx_voice
notes: voice of each effect id, FFh = none

name: sfx_script
notes: near pointers to effect scripts (DS:91BE..944B)

name: engine_script_note
notes: note byte of the engine script, patched by engine_sound

name: scene_music_buf
notes: 3630-byte buffer for <scene>A/B/C.MUS

name: music_buf
notes: THEME.MUS / NEWWAVE.MUS (6000 bytes inside the DS:E770 block)

name: master_vol
notes: added to music velocities (fade)

name: snd_ready
notes: bit 0 music ready, bit 2 effects ready

name: snd_active
notes: bit 0 music playing, bit 2 an effect was started (cleared by every voice_release)

name: music_ctl
notes: bit 4 loaded, 5 fade in, 6 fade out, 7 stop at loop point, bits 0-3 fade speed

name: snd_device_id
notes: 0 speaker, 1 Tandy, 2 CMS, 4 AdLib, 80h MPU-401

name: adlib_bd
notes: shadow of OPL register BDh

name: instr_progmap
notes: INSTR.DAT: program -> instrument (AdLib) / program sent

name: instr_veloff
notes: INSTR.DAT: velocity offset per program

name: instr_chmap
notes: INSTR.DAT: MIDI channel -> voice (>15 off)

name: instr_percmap
notes: INSTR.DAT: percussion note 36+ -> pitch/note

name: instr_count
notes: INSTR.DAT instrument count

name: instr_size
notes: INSTR.DAT instrument size

name: snd_default_tables
notes: defaults copied to C6B8 by snd_reset_tables

name: music_wait
notes: tick countdown to the next events

name: music_pos
notes: next event

name: music_status
notes: status byte of the current event

name: music_halt
notes: leave the event loop

name: loop_count
notes: per-voice loop state (index = voice); not reset by music_play: persists across songs

name: voice_noteword
notes: device note << 8 | fraction

name: voice_owner
notes: 0 free, 1 music, 2-4 effect slot+1

name: voice_note
notes: device note (AdLib: MIDI-19)

name: voice_busy
notes: note started this tick

name: cur_owner
notes: 1 music, slot+1 effects

name: engine_off
notes: Ctrl-V toggle

name: snd_device_ids
notes: device index -> C5E3

name: sfx_step_ptr
notes: = 1ace:0e55

name: sfx_modulate_ptr
notes: = 1ace:0d1c

name: mus_hook_ptr
notes: = 1ace:03d5 (ret)

name: dev_note_on_tbl
notes: per device index

name: music_handlers
notes: event types 0-7

name: adlib_fstep
notes: F-number per 1/16 semitone

name: adlib_fnum
notes: F-numbers for G..F#

name: adlib_op_offset
notes: slot -> operator register offset

name: adlib_voice_slots
notes: voice -> modulator/carrier slot, FFh single operator

name: adlib_inst_tl
notes: instrument 40h byte per slot; slots 16/17 overlap CA15[0..1] (harmless)

name: adlib_inst_conn
notes: instrument C0 bit 0 per voice (read per slot: quirk)

name: adlib_voice_inst
notes: default instrument per voice

name: adlib_perc_voice
notes: percussion note 36-75 -> rhythm voice 6-10 (15 none)

name: voice_sfx_id
notes: game effect id per voice

name: sfx_slot_voice
notes: FFh = free

name: sfx_ops
notes: opcode handlers 0-12 via [CB3C+2*op]; entry 0 overlaps sfx_slot_voice[1..2]

name: snd_nop
notes: ret: default device routine, speaker/Tandy/CMS program routine, music event hook DS:C914

name: radio_next
notes: key M: DS:B6CC = (B6CC+1) mod 3, music_for_state(B6CC), message 22h/27h/28h (radio station)

name: pit_divisor
notes: meant to be set to 2000h by timer_install, but the store runs with DS = CS and hits 185f:01b4; never read

name: instr_unused
notes: INSTR.DAT table block 100h-10Fh, never read

name: instr_data_seg
notes: segment of the instrument block (offset C96A stays 0)

name: instr_tmp_size
notes: instr_load scratch: section size, then count*size

name: instr_tmp_char
notes: instr_load scratch: device-name byte

name: mpu_bank_loaded
notes: MPU-401 bank loaded (parked)

name: snd_call_target
notes: scratch for the indirect calls of snd_tick and sfx_step

name: instr_ok
notes: instr_load result

name: spk_fstep
notes: PC speaker PIT divisor change per 1/16 semitone (-128..-63)

name: spk_divisor
notes: PC speaker PIT divisors C1..B1 (36485..19327), shifted right by the octave

name: sfx_unused
notes: cleared by sfx_slot_reset, never read

name: isr_chain_count
notes: timer ISR: chain to the old INT 8 every 8th tick

name: leg_siren_alt
notes: byte 4 of the leg map <scene>A..E.DAT (loaded to DS:9592): nonzero -> effect 20 becomes 23 (two-tone siren); 0 in all shipped legs

name: radio_station
notes: race song 0..2 -> <scene>A/B/C.MUS; 0 at start and scene select, key M cycles

name: damage_flags
notes: simulation damage bits; bit 5 (engine damage, likely) lowers the engine sound 4 semitones

name: replay_active
notes: instant replay: only effects 2 and 6, no engine sound, race song not started

name: shared_data_loaded
notes: NEWWAVE.MUS and menu data loaded (cleared by stage_load_objects)
